title: Solid Fungal Extraction and C8 Reversed Phase Chromatography
author: Shara Van De Pas

steps.title: Cultivate Fungus
steps.instruction: Subculture fungus onto approximately 40 Petri dishes of chosen media, seal with parafilm, and grow at the appropriate temperature until required age or coverage is reached.

steps.title: Freeze and Dry Fungal Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare the grown plates for extraction by freezing and lyophilizing.

substeps.instruction: Freeze plates overnight at -20 °C
Freeze dry over two days at -80 °C until plates are dry and crisp

steps.title: Determine Dry Weight
steps.instruction: Measure the mass of the dry fungal tissue.

substeps.instruction: Weigh a clean 500ml beaker
Break up dry fungal tissue into small pieces and add to the beaker
Reweigh the beaker to obtain the dry weight of the fungus

steps.title: Perform Methanol Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract fungal tissue using methanol and concentrate the extract.

substeps.instruction: Submerge dry fungal tissue in methanol (MeOH) for 4 hours
Filter the mixture into a 500ml round bottom flask
Dry at reduced pressure on a rotary evaporator at 130 mbar

steps.title: Perform Dichloromethane Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract fungal tissue using dichloromethane and concentrate the extract.

substeps.instruction: Re-submerge fungal tissue in dichloromethane (CH2Cl2)
Cover with tinfoil and leave to soak overnight
Filter the mixture into the same round bottom flask the following day
Dry at 500 mbar

steps.title: Collect Crude Product
steps.instruction: Remove a portion of the crude product from the flask for downstream biological testing.

steps.title: C8 Reversed-Phase Chromatography
steps.instruction: Separate the remaining crude product using C8 reversed-phase silica gel chromatography.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve the remaining crude product in 10%M MeOH
Load onto C8 reversed-phase silica gel
Elute with a gradient of H2O:MeOH (25% increments of 100ml volume) to afford five fractions (F1-F5)
Apply pump pressure and collect fractions in 250ml round bottom flasks

steps.title: Concentrate Fractions
steps.instruction: Dry the five collected fractions using a rotary evaporator at reduced pressure.

substeps.instruction: Dry MeOH fractions at 130mbar
Dry Water fractions at 40mbar

steps.title: Prepare NMR Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the dried fractions for NMR analysis.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.35-0.4ml of D4 MeOH to each flask (excluding Fraction 1, which contains sugars and salts) and mix
Draw the methanol-fungi mixture into a 1ml syringe and needle
Transfer the mixture into a clean, labelled NMR tube and cap gently

steps.title: Run NMR Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze samples using the AvanceIII-400mhz instrument with the following settings: Proton H+ 64 scans, Solvent: d4 Methanol.

steps.title: Prepare Biotesting Vials
steps.instruction: Transfer NMR samples to vials for biological testing.

substeps.instruction: Label and weigh 5 empty biotesting vials
Add the contents of the NMR tubes to the vials and allow to dry
Reweigh the dry tubes and label them with the mass in milligrams
Seal lids with Parafilm and send for extract testing
